description: This file contains shell script functions and commands related to managing pull request branches, pushing updates via both Git commands and GraphQL, and handling remote URLs and sha propagation for pull request workflows.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url
methods.description: Resolves the URL of the PR head repository, preferring username/repo format, falling back to PR_HEAD_REPO_URL, appending .git if missing.

methods.name: graphql_push_to_fork
methods.description: Uses GitHub GraphQL API to create a commit on a branch for pushing pull request updates, handling file additions and deletions.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url_https
methods.description: Resolves the HTTPS URL for the PR head repository, similar to resolve_head_push_url but specifically for HTTPS.

methods.name: verify_pr_head_branch_matches_expected
methods.description: Checks if the current PR head branch matches the expected head branch, exits if not.

methods.name: setup_prhead_remote
methods.description: Sets up the 'prhead' remote URL pointing to the PR head repository.

methods.name: resolve_prhead_remote_sha
methods.description: Fetches the latest SHA of the remote PR head branch, falling back to HTTPS if remote fetch fails.

methods.name: push_prep_head_to_pr_branch
methods.description: Main function to push the prepared head to the PR branch, handling push failures, retries, and fallbacks using GraphQL.

calls.note: Assumed to be a custom function not defined in the snippet
